instruction: Recover poster_party_night.webp from the Trash back to the Desktop and also place a copy in the Documents folder.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
